title: Trends in National Institutes of Health funding for clinical trials registered in ClinicalTrials.gov
authors: Ehrhardt S, Appel LJ, Meinert CL
authorConflicts: Appel reported NIH grants to conduct clinical trials; Meinert reported NIH grants and industry funding to conduct clinical trials.
result: Newly registered interventional trials by year first received, 2006 to 2014: NIH-funded 1376 to 1048 (328 fewer, 24%); industry-funded 4585 to 6550 (1965 more, 43%); all trials 9321 to 18,400.
